summary: Simplify Controller deployment and local controls. API impact: changed contract — DHCP/static mode, password bootstrap policy, persisted TLS identity and optional legacy power confirmation; preserve authorization/ownership.

guide.reason: Document DHCP/static choices, short passwords, simple power confirmation, lease recovery and required matched artifact rebuild.

api.reason: Update existing deployment/recovery/power and bootstrap contracts, defaults/validation/errors/retries, observed URL and agent TLS name with old-state compatibility.

state.reason: The persisted TLS identity is the Controller appliance identity (Controller CA material); DHCP/static mode is the appliance network configuration inside the guest.
state.record: Controller CA/TLS identity persisted in the appliance under /var/lib/nex-controller; backed up and restored by the appliance recovery export (host-recovery export/restore in docs/guide/deploy-controller-appliance.md); pools/hosts rows are mirrors re-adopted from host enrollment and reports.
